ABOUT ME

Hey There! Let me tell you a few things...

I am Jade A. Jaballa. A curious and cautious programmer for you. I may not look like it, act like it or sound like it, but I'm certainly an overthinker and a critical thinker that made me able to become a problem solver.

Did you know that because of this characteristic of mine, I almost feel like I'm a dumb? It's funny how I overthink and question even the most simple and obvious things that occur.

However, Paulo Coelho once said, "The simple things are also the most extraordinary things, and only the wise can see them."

So if you wanna see those extraordinary things come into virtual reality, reach out and let's work it out. Enjoy the simple things and I'll deal on what complicates.
